verdict.rationale: Users can author their own skills (writing-skills), and skills auto-trigger based on context: a SessionStart hook injects the bootstrap, and task cues route to skills (e.g. "Fix this bug" → systematic-debugging). Built-in workflow rules also fire automatically, such as architectural review after three failed fixes or a worktree after brainstorming. However, these triggers are LLM-interpreted conversational cues inside an agent session, not a deterministic rule/event engine. Missing for 10: user-definable deterministic event→action rules, support for external or system events (file changes, webhooks, schedules), and independent hands-on confirmation that custom triggers fire reliably.
